cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Hand It Over
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to give up control of a task, object, or decision you believe is being mishandled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Let me fix that cupboard hinge. The door's lower than when you started. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm just finding the right screw.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. You've tried four. Give me the screwdriver while you find it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you'll tell everyone you fixed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can announce the repair. I'll stand behind you with the screwdriver, keeping the door attached.
